jobs.occupation: SAP Digital Manufacturing Solution Consultant – Principal - Skövde
jobs.description:
Integro Consulting is looking for an experienced SAP Digital Manufacturing Solution Consultant for a consulting assignment with our client in Skövde.
Are you passionate about translating business needs into effective technical solutions? Do you enjoy working closely with manufacturing sites, business stakeholders, and development teams? This is an opportunity to contribute to the development and maintenance of production-critical IT systems in a global manufacturing environment.
About the Assignment
You will join our client's global team, responsible for the entire lifecycle of manufacturing IT solutions, from requirements gathering and implementation to maintenance and continuous improvement.
Your primary focus will be SAP Digital Manufacturing (SAP DM), where you will translate business requirements into reliable solutions through hands-on configuration and collaboration with development teams.
Our client is transitioning towards a more agile, product-oriented way of working, with a focus on improving delivery speed, quality, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with manufacturing sites and stakeholders to understand business requirements.
Design and configure Production Process Designs (PPDs) and Production Operator Dashboards (PODs) in SAP DM.
Support implementations, global rollouts, system upgrades, and quarterly SAP DM releases.
Provide technical support and expertise to manufacturing sites.
Maintain and continuously improve manufacturing IT applications.
Collaborate with development teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Participate in the on-call rotation for production-critical systems.

Required Qualifications
Hands-on experience implementing and configuring SAP Digital Manufacturing (SAP DM).
Experience with SAP integrations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and spoken English.
A structured, quality-focused approach and strong communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.

Meritorious experience:
Background in the automotive industry.
Experience with manufacturing IT and production environments.
Experience working in agile teams or product-oriented organizations.

Who Are You?
You are an analytical and proactive professional who takes ownership and enjoys turning complex business needs into practical technical solutions. You value teamwork, open communication, and continuous improvement, and you are committed to delivering reliable, high-quality solutions.
Apply Today
Join Integro Consulting and contribute to an exciting consulting assignment with our client, helping shape the future of digital manufacturing.

Are you an experienced C++ Developer with a passion for telecom software development and real-time systems? Do you thrive in a highly technical, collaborative, and innovative environment, working on the core of 5G Baseband and RAN?

Debug and troubleshoot complex telecom software using GDB, Wireshark, and log analysis tools.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.
Read, analyze, and implement 3GPP specifications and coding standards.

Key Competences:
BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field.
4+ years of experience in telecom software development.
Experience with real-time systems, Baseband, and RAN software development.
Knowledge and experience in 5G or 4G wireless communication.
Strong programming skills in C/C++ (required) and experience with Linux, multithreading, and low-latency systems.
Familiarity with telecom protocols MAC (scheduler) & L1 standards
AI-assisted software development, testing, debugging, and code generation would be a plus
Ability to read, analyze, and implement technical documentation and coding standards.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.
